headline: Crypto’s infrastructure era arrives, with AI agents poised to reshape demand
detail: This headline points to a significant tailwind for your tech and chip-heavy portfolio. Increased demand for crypto infrastructure and AI agents means more underlying hardware and software will be needed, directly benefiting chip manufacturers and tech companies.
rec: Consider AMD, a chip name, for a new buy. Its scanner setup shows an entry at 482.21-481.73 with a stop at 479.08, aligning with this demand.
